Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

pondeR 1.0.0

First CRAN release.

Breaking changes

  • Plot text now has one control. base_size defaults to 11, which suits a default 7 x 5 inch Quarto figure, and scales all text. global_font_size and zoom are removed. title_size, subtitle_size, xlab_size, ylab_size, axis_text_size, legend_size, label_size and similar arguments default to NULL, which follows base_size.
  • Duplicate or unused arguments are removed: plot_bar(values_position, axis_title_size), plot_diff(plot_vars, posthoc) (use outcome), run_auc(compute_auc) and plot_dend(leaf_label_size).
  • Output tables have report-ready column names, such as Adjusted p-value, 95% CI lower and Fold change, so code that reads the old names needs updating. run_foldchange() keeps per-feature values under short names in $feature_stats.
  • run_randomize(), run_subset() and run_regreg() set a random seed only when seed is supplied.
  • save_excel() and save_plots() no longer write to the working directory by default. Supply filename, folder, or both.

New features

  • Functions that take data accept dimsprepr::run_DIpreprocess() results directly, including custom group columns and merged replicates. Results from several preprocessing methods give a clear error asking you to pick one.
  • plot_score() works without color_by and points_from, using the fitted groups and row names.
  • run_lefse() gains a print() method.

Bug fixes

  • plot_meanmap(): rows no longer appear mirrored against the dendrogram, and cluster labels are no longer clipped.
  • plot_diff() now reads formatted p-values correctly when given a run_diff() summary table.
  • run_correl(): automatic selection no longer rejects Pearson correlation because of unequal variances, and Spearman and Kendall confidence intervals use the Fieller (1957) standard errors.
  • run_pca() always centers the data, and run_pca() and run_pls() now record which groups were excluded.
  • run_pls() no longer draws diagnostic plots while fitting. These wrote Rplots.pdf to the working directory in non-interactive sessions and added unwanted figures to reports.
  • run_diff(calculate_effect_size = FALSE) is now honoured.
  • print() and summary() work for multi-outcome run_diff() results.
  • run_relabel() recodes all labels at once, so chained labels such as A -> B, B -> C are correct, and several labels can merge into one.
  • run_reduce() results now have their class, so they print correctly.
  • run_lefse() handles missing values.
  • get_groupsizes(show_summary_table = TRUE) no longer fails.
  • plot_relabund() honours ignore_normalization, no longer prints from inside the function, and no longer needs a dimsprepr method that was removed.
  • run_auc(): the legend title follows ci_level, and labels stay correct when confidence intervals are turned off.
  • plot_multi_y(): default colours are distinct across all series.
  • plot_dend(): long leaf labels are no longer cut off.
  • plot_heatmap(): non-significant crosses no longer hide the coefficients.
  • run_randomize(): the default per = "none" samples intact rows. The previous default scrambled every cell across the table.
  • run_lefse(): LDA effect sizes follow Segata et al. (2011).
  • run_pca() and run_pls() need ‘dimsprepr’ only when scale_method or transform_method is used.
  • print() and as_gt() for run_correl() results show the correlation table.
  • as_gt() forwards gtsummary tables to gtsummary::as_gt().
  • save_excel(list()) no longer calls a missing internal function.
  • plot_bar() value labels follow dodged, stacked and filled bars.
  • run_summarytable() no longer warns about mark_posthoc_significance on default calls.
  • plot_scree() no longer warns when max_pc exceeds the number of components.

Package infrastructure

  • Examples run without \dontrun{}, and slow ones use \donttest{}.
  • Unit tests cover every exported function.
  • References with DOIs are given for the statistical methods.
  • Fewer required dependencies: ‘magrittr’, ‘moments’, ‘purrr’, ‘reshape2’, ‘scales’, ‘tibble’ and ‘viridis’ are no longer used, and ‘lme4’ and ‘lmerTest’ are optional.
